title: Describing changes over time / Ukubhala iziguqulo ngexesha
bridge: NgisiNgisi, ukubhala iziguqulo kusetshenziswa amaqembu anathi 'get', 'become' futhi 'turn' okungahluleka kuhunyushwa njengo 'ponerse', 'hacerse' noma 'volverse' ngesiSipeyini. Ngokungalikele ngesiSipeyini, isiNgisi alisetshenzisyi isibhalo 'ser' noma 'estar' namabhala ukuze kubonakale isiguqulo; kunokwenzeka, kusetshenziswa lawa mavusi amahlulelane. Ngaphambi kwalokho, isiNgisi iyahlukanisa phakathi kwesikhathi esihle ('have changed') nesikhathi esidlulile ('changed'), okungavumelani ngokwanele nesikhathi esihle nesikhathi esidlulile ngesiSipeyini. Abafundi abasiSipeyini baya kuhunyusha ngokungafani 'estoy más cansado' njengo 'I am more tired' kunokuba 'I have gotten more tired'.
rule: Ukuvula iziguqulo ngisiNgisi: 1) Setha 'get' + isibhalo (noma isibonakalisi) kweziguqulo eziphambene noma eziphambene: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Setha 'become' + isibhalo/isibhalo kweziguqulo ezinamandla noma eziqondile: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Setha 'turn' + ubala noma isibhalo kweziguqulo ezibonakalayo: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Kweziguqulo ezinhle noma ezinhle, ngezakho 'grow' (ukukhula) futhi 'fall' (ukwehla) emazwini afakwe: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) Nge 'used to' kusho izimo zamandulo azikho: 'I used to live here'. 6) Nge 'no longer' futhi 'still' ukubalalisa izimo: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Isikhathi esihle kusetshenziswa lapho isiguqulo singcono ngaleso sikhathi: 'The town has changed a lot'. Awusetshenziswa 'ser' noma 'estar' + isibhalo njengesiSipeyini: 'estoy cansado' akusiyo 'I am tired' uma ufuna ukusho ukuthi uqale ukuba noyidini, kodwa 'I have gotten tired'.

common_error.wrong: I am more tired now than before.
common_error.correct: I have gotten more tired now.
common_error.correct_alt: I have become more tired now.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siphambana ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSipeyini kusho 'estoy más cansado' ukuze kubonakale isiguqulo sezimo. Kodwa ngisiNgisi, 'I am tired' iyabhalela izimo zamansukela, hhayi isiguqulo. Ukubhala ukuthi kune isiguqulo, kumelwe usebenzise isikhathi esihle nge 'get' noma 'become' (noma 'have gotten' / 'have become'). Ungasho 'I am more tired' kuphela uma ubalalisa namasaga abunye, kodwa awukubikeli ukuthi kune isiguqulo. Shayisa ukuhunyushwa okungafani futhi cinga ngokuthi uyabhalela izimo noma isiguqulo.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Ukucabanga kanye nokwenza izinqumo
bridge: Ngesi, siyathusa 'must be' okanye 'might be' ukuze sicabange. NgesiNgisi, siyathusa amamodali 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' + infinitive. Isihloko ngokuthi 'must' iveza inqumo enesibonelo esingcono (eyipozitive) kanye 'can't' iveza ukuba akukho; 'might', 'may' kanye 'could' iveza ukuba kukhona isici esingcono. Qaphela: ungathusi 'must not' ukuze uveze okwengueke, ngoba ngesiNgisi 'must not' iveza ukuba akukho.
rule: Ukuze sicabange ngesiNgisi, siyathusa amamodali alandelayo eduze isibonelo somsebenzi: 'must' (inqumo enesibonelo esingcono ukuba into iyinyaniso), 'can't' (inqumo enesibonelo esingcono ukuba into ayinyaniso), 'might', 'may', 'could' (isici, esingcono). Ukuze sicabange ngokubhalwa, siyathusa 'must have + past participle', 'can't have + past participle', 'might have + past participle', njll. Isimo ngokuthi: umsebenzi + modal + isibonelo somsebenzi (esikhathini esijulile) okanye modal + have + past participle (esikhathini esidluleile). Isiqeto: ngesi, 'debe de ser' kanye 'no puede ser' zilingana, kodwa ngesiNgisi asitsi 'must not be' ukuze uveze okwengueke; siyathusa 'can't be'.

concept_examples.text: He must be tired after the long trip.

concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst biː ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə lɔːŋ trɪp/

concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt biː ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈmuːvɪŋ tuː əˈnʌðər ˈkʌntri/

concept_examples.text: They might have forgotten the meeting.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtən ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: It could rain later, so take an umbrella.
concept_examples.translation: Mhlawumbe izimpethu ziya kuwehla emva kwesikhathi, ngakho-ke thatha isibane.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrelə/

common_error.wrong: He must not be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct: He can't be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct_alt: He must be out because the lights are off.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sikhathakala ngoba ngesi sithi 'no debe estar' ukuze siveze inqumo engamandla, kodwa ngesiNgisi, 'must not' iveza ukuba akukho ('no debe' = akukho umvuzo). Ukuze uveze ukuba into ayinyaniso okanye ayinyaniso, siyathusa 'can't' (okanye 'couldn't' ukuze siveze ukuba kukhona isici esingcono). Intandane 'must be out' iyinyaniso ngoba umthelela uyalingana: ukuveza ukuba akukho ekhaya.

examples.original: You're a journalist. You must meet a lot of people.

examples.translation: Ungomphathi wabafundi. Mhlawumbe uyakwazi abantu abaningi.
examples.note: Siyathusa 'must' lapho sinesibonelo esingcono ngento. Ngesi, 'debe de'.

examples.original: That can't be the right answer.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt kænt biː ðə raɪt ˈænsər/
examples.note: Siyathusa 'can't' ukuze siveze ukuba into ayinyaniso. Ngesi, 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: He must have a lot of money because he drives a Ferrari.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ə lɒt əv ˈmʌni bɪˈkɒz hiː draɪvz ə fəˈrɑːri/

examples.note: Isizathu sikhonywa nge-'because' (ngoba) kanye siveza inqumo.

examples.original: They may arrive late because of the traffic.

examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ˈstʌdid ə lɒt fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/

examples.original: She can't have seen us because she didn't wave.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt hæv siːn ʌs bɪˈkɒz ʃiː dɪdnt weɪv/
examples.note: 'Can't have + past participle' iveza inqumo engamandla ngokubhalwa. Ngesi, 'no puede haber'.

examples.original: They might have missed the bus.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Ukubika ukudelela nokubika kwendimana
bridge: NgesiSpani, usebenzisa isicono nesubjunktivi ukukhuluma ngendimana nokudelela (ngokwesibonelo, 'si tuviera tiempo, iría'). Ngesi, isakhiwo siyahlukile: usebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo (okanye isikhathi esidlulileyo esingcwele) kwisigaquli 'if' futhi 'would' + isibhalo kwisigaquli esikhulu. Iphutha elichanekileyo yikuhumusha ngokwenhloso 'si tendría' njengesithi 'if I would have', kodwa ngesi isigaquli 'if' asikwazi 'would'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhuluma ngendlela eyingozi ngosuku oludlulileyo, usebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo esingcwele ('had + participio') esikhundleni sesicono esihlanganisiwe.
rule: Ngesi B1, ukubika ukudelela kwesikhathi esihamba okanye esizayo (isigaquli esivesiyowe), usebenzisa 'if + isikhathi esidlulileyo' (okanye 'if + isikhathi esidlulileyo esidlulileyo') kwisigaquli esigaquli, futhi 'would + isibhalo esisodwa' kwisigaquli esikhulu. Izibonelo: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (Uma benginehlonipho, ngizohamba). Buka ukuthi 'were' usetshenziswa zonke izinsizwa nge-'if I were' (nakhu 'was' kunjalo ngesi engasemi). Ukubika ukudelela ngosuku oludlulileyo (isigaquli esithathu), usebenzisa 'if + isikhathi esidlulileyo esingcwele' (had + participio) futhi 'would have + participio' kwesikhulu: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (Uma bengikhomba, bengizokuphumelela). Ungasebenzise 'I wish' + isikhathi esidlulileyo esingcwele ukudelela: 'I wish I had studied.' (Ngifisa bengikhomba). Khumbula ukuthi isigaquli 'if' asikwazi 'would' okanye 'will'. Kwindlela ezimbalwa, 'were' iyathandeka: 'If he were here...'.

concept_examples.text: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd mɔːr ˈmʌni aɪ wʊd baɪ ə kɑːr/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I'd go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Iphutha iyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSpani sisho 'si tendría tiempo' (isicono), kodwa ngesi isigaquli 'if' asikwazi 'would'. Esikhundleni salokho, sisebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo (had). Ukuba uqhubeke iphutha, khumbula ukuthi 'if' iselula isikhathi esidlulileyo (ukubika kwesikhathi esihamba okanye esizayo) okanye isikhathi esidlulileyo esingcwele (ukubika kwesikhathi elidlulileyo), futhi 'would' iselula kwesigaquli esikhi.

title: Discussing Advantages and Disadvantages / Ukudlulisela izilungisele nobubi
bridge: Ngesiporutheni siqukethwe ukusebenzisa 'izilungisele' nobubi' njengesimiso, kodwa ngesiNgisi kunzima ukusetshenziswa amagama esithi 'advantages' noba 'disadvantages' namavhesi njengo- 'have' noma 'there are'. Ngaphambi kwesiNgisi, kushunyaywe 'pros and cons' emazwilini asekelivi, okungaba yikho okungafaneli ngesiPorutheni. Khathalela ukungahambisani ngokugcwele 'ngenkinga yomunye uphahla' njengo 'for one side' – isisho esifanelekile yingo- 'on the one hand'.
rule:
Ukudlulisela izilungisele nobubi ngesiNgisi ehlela B1, sebenzisa lawa migaqo:
1. 'One advantage (of) is that...' / 'One disadvantage (of) is that...' – landelana nomqondo onomsebenzi nenkomba.
2. 'The advantages of + isicazulo/isikhathi sindawonye are...' ukubala.
3. 'On the one hand... on the other hand...' ukudlulisela amavesi amabili.
4. 'However' noma 'Nevertheless' ukusokomisa ububanzi emva kokudlulisela okungcono.
5. 'Pros and cons' yisisho esimanywayo esebenza njengesimiso esisodwa: 'Let's weigh the pros and cons.'
Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi awusetshenziswa 'of' emva kwenkomba 'advantage' uma akukho isicazulo esilandelayo: 'It has many advantages' (hhayi 'advantages of').

concept_examples.text: On the other hand, the cost of living is much higher.
concept_examples.translation: Ngenye isikhathi, ingxenye yokuhlala khona iyakhulu kakhulu.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɒn ðə ˈʌðə hænd, ðə kɒst əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪz mʌtʃ ˈhaɪə

concept_examples.text: A major disadvantage of working from home is that you may feel isolated.
concept_examples.translation: Obubi obukhulu bokusebenza emkhukhwini yikuthi ungaba nomoya wokuhlaliseka.
concept_examples.phonetic: ə ˈmeɪdʒə ˌdɪsədˈvɑːntɪdʒ əv ˈwɜːkɪŋ frɒm həʊm ɪz ðæt juː meɪ fiːl ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd

common_error.wrong: The advantages of the internet are many, but for one side it can be dangerous.
common_error.correct: The advantages of the internet are many, but on the one hand it can be dangerous.
common_error.correct_alt: The advantages of the internet are many, but it can also be dangerous.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sivela ukuhambisana ngokugcwele 'ngenkinga yomunye uphahla' njengo 'for one side', kodwa ngesiNgisi isisho esifanelekile yingo- 'on the one hand' (nakuba 'on the other hand' ukudlulisela). Ngenye isikhathi, kukhona ukungahlekelwa 'hand' futhi kushone 'on one side', okungafanelekile. title: Narrating a story / Ukubalalisa indaba okanye isheshini
bridge: NesiSpani, ukuze ubalise ngokubhalwayo siyathusa izikhathi eziqondile (pretérito indefinido) neziqhubekayo (imperfecto), futhi ukuxanana phakathi kwazo kuhlukile. NgesiNgisi, isimo sijongile kodwa neminathi ehlukile: 'past simple' siyathusa ukwenza imisebenzi eyekile, futhi 'past continuous' siyathusa imisebenzi eyayisekudingekwa ngaphambili. Iphutha elinganisayo yikuthi ukuhumusha ngokomthelele 'estaba + gerundio' kusiSpani ukuze kufike kusiNgisi, kodwa ngesiNgisi ngokuvamile siyathusa 'used to' okanye 'would' ukuze sikhombise izilinganiso eziqhubekayo, okungabikho ngisho engesiSpani. Nalo nalutho, ngesiNgisi, 'past perfect' (had + participio) kukhona ngokuvamile kunokho 'pluscuamperfecto' kusiSpani ukuze kubonakale ukubalwa phambili kwesibali.
rule:
Ukuze ubalise indaba ngesiNgisi ehlela B1, umelwe udlale ngalezi zikhathi zezihloko:
1. **Past Simple** (okuhambisana: inhloko + izikhathi zezihloko, wonke umfanekiso 'walked'; okungahambisani: 'didn't + izikhathi zezihloko'; okubuza: 'Did + inhloko + izikhathi zezihloko?'). Siyathusa imisebenzi eyekile njengemikhasi, ngokomthelele.
2. **Past Continuous** (was/were + izikhathi zezihloko -ing). Siyabalalisa imisebenzi eyayisekudingekwa ngaphambili ngesikhathi esidlule, ngokuvamile ishasalwa yimisebenzi eyekile (past simple).
3. **Past Perfect** (had + izikhathi zezihloko eziqondile). Ikhombisa umsebenzi owenzeka ngaphambi kwenye ngesikhathi esidlule. Awusekho kangakanani njengesiSpani, kodwa iyafuza ukucacisa izinhlobo.
4. **'Used to'** (inhloko + used to + izikhathi zezihloko ezisodwa) ukuze sikhombise izilinganiso okanye izimo zokudlulela eziyisimo.
5. **'Would'** ukuze sikhombise izilinganiso zokudlulela (kwesibali esihambisana okanye esibalelwe).
Izinhlobo zosizo: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', njalo. Ziyasiza ukwakha isibali.
Izimpawu: izikhathi zezihloko ezihlukile (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Khumbula ukuthi ngokungahambisani nokubuza siyathusa 'did' nezihloko zezihloko.
Kuze kuhlela B1, hhayi 'past perfect continuous' (kakhulu).

Kodwa 'used to' sekusho ukuthi kusedlule futhi akuthwali 'was/were'. Futhi bacindezela nendlela 'be used to + gerundio' eyethi 'ukuba noma ungakithi'. Ukuze izilinganiso zokudlulela, ithusa 'used to + izikhathi zezihloko ezisodwa' okanye 'would + izikhathi zezihloko ezisodwa' (ngaphandle kwesebenza).

title: Arguing a point of view / Ukubeka isiqondo setholakele
bridge: Ngesibhashu, ukuze sikhundanise siqhubeka ukusebenzisa amazwi njengokuthi 'ngiyakholelwa' noma 'ngiyakholelwa ukuthi', futhi nakhathesi siyadonsa isibhalo ngenxa yokuthi isibhalo sikubikele. NgesiNgisi, isibhalo siyadingeka futhi siqhubeka ukusebenzisa izinhlelo njengokuthi 'Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi...' noma 'Ngokwami...'. Ngaphakathi kweziNgisi, kune ukuthanda ukusebenzisa 'should' ukuze khiphe izinqumo noma izinhloso, ngesibhashu siqhubeka ukusebenzisa 'debería' noma 'tendría que'. Qaphela ukungayithengisi ngokungaphezulu 'ngiyakholelwa ukuthi' njengokuthi 'I think that' (okuhle) kodwa ungakhohlwa isibhalo: 'Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi' = 'I think that' (hhayi 'Think that'). Inye isiphambano esikhathesi ngukusebenzisa 'I am agree' esikhundleni 'I agree', ngenxa yokuthi ngesiNgisi 'agree' yisibhalo esisodwa, hhayi isibhalo esisodwa.
rule:
Ukuze ukhombise isiqondo setholakele ngesiNgisi ehlela B1, sebenzisa izinhlelo ezilandelayo:

1. **Ukukhombisa ukubona:** 'Ngiyakholelwa (ukuthi)...', 'Ngiyakholelwa (ukuthi)...', 'Ngokwami...', 'Ngesiqondomi...'. Isibonelo: 'Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ukusebenza ngokomthetho kuhle.'
2. **Ukunika izizathu:** 'ngoba', 'kungenxa yokuthi', 'njengoba'. Isibonelo: 'Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi siyadingeka ukusindisa amanzi ngoba kuhle kakhulu ekupheni.'
3. **Ukunika izinhloso noma ukukhombisa:** 'should' + isibhalo esisodwa (hhayi 'to'). Isibonelo: 'Abantu bayadingeka ukusebenzisa izixhobo zokuhamba ngokubanzi.'
4. **Ukubeka okungafani / okungafani:** 'Ngiyavuma', 'Angiyavumi', 'Ngiyavuma nawe', 'Angiyavumi'. Inothi: 'agree' yisibhalo, hhayi isibhalo esisodwa, ngakho-ke ungayisebenzisi 'be + agree'. Isibonelo: 'Ngiyavuma nekhombisa lwakho.' (Hhayi: 'I am agree').
5. **Ukubhekana:** 'Kodwa', 'kodwa', 'ngalinye igama'. Isibonelo: 'Abanye abantu bacabanga njalo, kodwa ngingavumi.'

Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi isibhalo siyadingeka njalo, nasezimpilweni eziphansi: 'Ngiyavuma' hhayi 'Avuma'. Futhi, 'think' futhi 'believe' zingasebenzise 'that' (okuchazwe) noma ngokuthuluza isibhalo. Kuze kube B1, kuhle ukusebenzisa 'that' ukuze kukhanye.

title: Talking about your job and career / Khuluma ngomsebenzi wakho nomfundo wakho
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, siyahlangana nesiga se- 'trabajar' kanye nesetshenziswa se- 'de' (trabajo de médico), kepha ngesiNgisi, siyasetshenzisa isiga se- 'work as' (I work as a doctor) okanye kuphela 'be' (I am a doctor). Ngaphandle kwalokho, isiNgisi iyahlukanisa kucacile phakathi kwesiga se- 'work' (isihloko esijwayelekile) no- 'job' (umsebenzi oqondile), ngesiporutheni, siyasetshenzisa 'trabajo' kubombini. Qaphela futhi ku-present simple: ngesiPorutheni singahlehla umphathi, kepha ngesiNgisi kufuneka usukume.
rule:
Ukukhuluma ngomsebenzi nomfundo ngesiNgisi e-B1, usebenzisa:
- Present simple ukubalela umsebenzi wakho okusemuhla: 'I work as a teacher' (ngingumfundisi) okanye 'I am a teacher'.
- 'Work in' + isikhundla okanye indawo (I work in a hospital), 'work for' + inkampani (I work for Microsoft), 'work with' + abantu okanye izinto (I work with children).
- Ukukhuluma ngomfundo wakho, usebenzisa 'career' (indlela) no- 'job' (umsebenzi oqondile). Ngokwesibonelo: 'I'm looking for a new job' (ngiyafuna umsebenzi omusha), 'She has a successful career' (unayomfundo oqhubekayo).
- Ukubeka amalungelo okanye izinkolelo zokufika, usebenzisa 'would like to' + infinitive (I'd like to change careers) okanye 'planning to' (I'm planning to look for a new job).
- Khumbula amagama akhona: 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' ukukhuluma ngemilinganiselo yasebenza.

concept_examples.text: He has a successful career in marketing.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː hæz ə səkˈsɛsfəl kəˈrɪr ɪn ˈmɑːrkɪtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: I would like to become a manager.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈmænɪdʒər/

common_error.explanation: NgesiPorutheni, sithi 'trabajo de doctor', kepha ngesiNgisi, isetshenziswa esihle ngokwe- 'as' (work as) hhayi 'like'. 'Like' siyasetshenzisa ukulinganisa (I work like a dog). Ukuba uqaphe le mfanelo, khumbula ukuthi 'work as' siyabonisela umsebenzi, ngakabe 'work like' yilinganiselo. Ungasetshenzisa ngokukodwa 'be' (I am a doctor) ukubalela umsebenzi wakho.

examples.original: I work in a hospital.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɜːrk ɪn ə ˈhɑːspɪtəl/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'work in' ezindaweni okanye ezikhundleni. Ungasho 'work at' lapha (nakhu 'at' siyasetshenzisa ezikhepheni ezaziwayo).

examples.original: I work for a big company.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɜːrk fɔːr ə bɪɡ ˈkʌmpəni/
examples.note: 'Work for' siyasetshenzisa noma enkampani okanye uhlobo lwenkampani. NgesiPorutheni 'trabajo para' siyalinganisa no- 'work for'.

examples.original: I work with customers.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɜːrk wɪð ˈkʌstəmərz/
examples.note: 'Work with' siyabonisela abantu okanye izinto onasebenza nabo. Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi kufuneka usukume.

examples.original: I am a receptionist.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst/
examples.note: Ezimphefumulweni, ngesiNgisi siyasetshenzisa 'be' + 'a/an'. Ungasetshenzisi 'work as' emizuzweni enomphathi (kodwa kuhle 'I work as a receptionist').

examples.original: I want to change my career.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɑːnt tə tʃeɪndʒ maɪ kəˈrɪr/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'career' ukukhuluma ngomfundo, hhayi 'job'. NgesiPorutheni 'carrera' siyabalisa umsebenzi.

examples.original: She has worked here for five years.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː hæz wɜːrkt hɪr fɔːr faɪv jɪrz/
examples.note: Sebenzisa present perfect no- 'for' ukubonisela isikhathi. NgesiPorutheni siyasetshenzisa 'llevar + gerundio' (lleva trabajando cinco años).

examples.original: I'm looking for a better opportunity.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔːr ə ˈbɛtər ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti/
examples.note: Present continuous siyasetshenzisa ezokwenzakalweni eziqhubekayo. NgesiPorutheni 'estoy buscando' siyalinganisa.

examples.original: He got a promotion last month.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɡɒt ə prəˈmoʊʃən læst mʌnθ/
examples.note: Sebenzisa past simple ezokwenzakalweni edlulile ezaziwayo. 'Got a promotion' siyabalisa ukukhulelwa.

examples.original: I'd like to start my own business.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈbɪznəs/
examples.note: 'Would like to' siyabeka amalungelo ngendlela ehloniphekile. NgesiPorutheni siyasetshenzisa 'me gustaría' + infinitive.

examples.original: I'm planning to quit my job.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈplænɪŋ tə kwɪt maɪ dʒɑːb/
examples.note: 'Planning to' + infinitive. 'Quit' siyabalisa ukushiya. Qaphela: 'quit' siyasetshenzisa ngokuhlula; 'resign' siyasetshenzisa ngokwethembeka.

examples.original: I'm going to study for a certificate.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi fɔːr ə sərˈtɪfɪkət/
examples.note: 'Going to' siyabeka izinkolelo zokufika. NgesiPorutheni 'ir a' + infinitive siyalinganisa.

examples.original: I hope to become a manager someday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈmænɪdʒər ˈsʌmdeɪ/
examples.note: 'Hope to' + infinitive siyabeka amalungelo okufika. NgesiPorutheni 'esperar + infinitivo'.

title: Describing processes / Indlela yokushoyo izindlela (kanjani into esebenza)
bridge: NgesiSpani, sivamise ukushoyo izindlela ngokusebenzisa izwi elingumthetho elisebenzisa 'se' (ngokwesibonelo, 'se calienta el agua') noma iprezente yesiGriki. NgeNgisi, kumnandi ukusebenzisa izwi elingumthetho elisebenzisa 'is/are + participio' (ngokwesibonelo, 'the water is heated') nabahleli bekhansi njengokuthi 'first', 'then', 'next', 'after that', 'finally'. Isixandu esibalulekile ngokuthi ngesiSpani sivamise ukushiya umphathi, kodwa ngeNgisi izwi elingumthetho livamise ukulibeka noma ukusebenzisa umfano ongawasebenzi nge- 'you' noma 'they'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, umwebo wamazwi ngeNgisi ungowakho: kuqala umphathi, emva kwalokho isazisi, futhi amazwi okwasabeka ahamba phambi kwesazisi esibalulekile kodwa emva kwe- 'be'.
rule: Ukushoyo izindlela ngeNgisi ehlelo B1, sivamise ukusebenzisa iprezente yesiGriki (kubalulekile izinto eziqondile) nezwi elingumthetho (iprezente elingumthetho: am/is/are + izenzelo zamandulo) lapho isibopho sikubona ngokwenza futhi hhayi ngokubani okwenza. Uhlelo oluthe ngoku: Kuqala, [into] is/are + izenzelo zamandulo. Emva kwalokho sivamise ukwengeza abahleli bekhansi: kuqala, emva kwalokho, emva kwalokho, emva kwalokho, emva kwalokho, emva kwalokho. Ngeke sivamise ukusebenzisa umthetho (njengokwesekeleni) noma 'you' ongawasebenzi. Izwi elingumthetho livamise ukwenzeka: umphathi + isazisi 'to be' elibhalwe + izenzelo zamandulo. Ngokwesibonelo: 'The coffee is ground.' Ungakhalali ukuthi amazwi okwasabeka (always, usually, often) ahamba phambi kwesazisi esibalulekile kodwa emva kwe- 'be' (ngokwesibonelo, 'The water is always heated first'). NgeNgisi, ngokungaliphansi kweSpani, asivamisi 'se' kwezwi elingumthetho; sivamise ukusebenzisa izwi elingumthetho elisebenzisa 'be' noma umfano osebenza nge- 'you'.

concept_examples.text: First, the coffee beans are ground.
concept_examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst ðə ˈkɒfi biːnz ɑːr ɡraʊnd/

concept_examples.text: Then the water is heated to 90 degrees.
concept_examples.translation: Emva kwalokho amanzi asukelwa ku 90 degrees.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðen ðə ˈwɔːtər ɪz ˈhiːtɪd tə naɪnti dɪˈɡriːz/

concept_examples.text: After that, the coffee is poured into a cup.
concept_examples.translation: Emva kwalokho, ikhi lo kofi lisakwa enkabini.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðæt ðə ˈkɒfi ɪz pɔːrd ˈɪntuː ə kʌp/

concept_examples.text: Finally, the cup is served with milk or sugar.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokuphakeme, inkaba ishiwi nelasi noma ishukela.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli ðə kʌp ɪz sɜːrvd wɪð mɪlk ɔːr ˈʃʊɡər/

common_error.wrong: First, the coffee beans are grinded.
common_error.correct: First, the coffee beans are ground.
common_error.correct_alt: First, we grind the coffee beans.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano esiqondile kakhulu ukusebenzisa 'grinded' njengomlando ka 'grind'. NgeNgisi, 'grind' yisazisi esingaliphakanyiswa: ground, ground. Abantu abashengane ngeSpani bavamise ukusebenzisa umthetho oqondile (-ed) ngenxa yokuthi ngeSpani imininingwane yamavesi amaningi ayiqondile. Ukuze kuhhekwe, kubalulekile ukukhumbula imininingwane yamavesi eyingaliphakanyiswa eziqondile kakhulu ekweni, njengokuthi 'grind-ground-ground'.

examples.original: First, the water is boiled.
examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst ðə ˈwɔːtər ɪz bɔɪld/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'first' ukubala indlela.

examples.original: Then, the pasta is added.
examples.phonetic: /ðen ðə ˈpɑːstə ɪz ˈædɪd/
examples.note: 'Then' ichaza iseqhelo esilandelayo.

examples.original: Finally, the dish is served.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli ðə dɪʃ ɪz sɜːrvd/
examples.note: 'Finally' ivala iseqhelo.

examples.original: The door is locked automatically.
examples.phonetic: /ðə dɔːr ɪz lɒkt ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli/
examples.note: Izwi elingumthetho elisebenzisa 'is + locked'.

examples.original: The emails are sent every morning.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈiːmeɪlz ɑːr sent ˈevri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.note: Izwi elingumthetho elisebenzisa 'are + sent'.

examples.original: The results are checked by the manager.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑːr tʃɛkt baɪ ðə ˈmænɪdʒər/
examples.note: Ukubeka umphathi nge- 'by'.

examples.original: You press the button to start.
examples.phonetic: /juː prɛs ðə ˈbʌtən tə stɑːrt/
examples.note: 'You' ongawasebenzi uyavumelana ne- 'se' ngeSpani.

examples.original: You insert the card here.
examples.phonetic: /juː ɪnˈsɜːrt ðə kɑːrd hɪər/
examples.note: Umfano wengane.

examples.original: First, mix the ingredients.
examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst mɪks ði ɪnˈɡriːdiənts/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa umthetho wesekeleni.

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / Ukubika ukungavumelani nokubanjwa
bridge: Ngesiporutheni siyanisa isubjunthivi noma amazwi okunqula njengo 'maybe' ne 'perhaps' ukubika ukungavumelani, kepha ngesiNgisi akukho isubjunthivi ejwayelekile; kunye nalokho, siyanisa amavhesi eziyingozi njengo 'might' ne 'could' noma amazwi okunqula njengo 'maybe' ne 'perhaps'. Qaphela: 'must' akusiyo 'special' ukubika ukubanjwa, kepha uyavisa ukubeka okuningi (must be).
rule: Ukubika ukungavumelani ngesiNgisi, siyanisa: 1) Amazwi okunqula: 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'probably', 'definitely' (ephakathi noma emva kwesibhalo). 2) Amavhesi eziyingozi: 'may', 'might', 'could' ukubika ukubanjwa (may/might ziyabalulekile kabanzi; could iyabalulekile kabanzi ephambanweni). 3) 'Must' ukubeka okuningi: 'She must be at home'. 4) Isimo 'be likely to' noma 'be unlikely to' ukubika ukubanjwa. Ezinye izinto, siyanisa 'might not' noma 'may not' (akukho 'could not' ukubika ukubanjwa, ngenxa yokuthi 'couldn't' uthi ukwazi okwedlule).

concept_examples.text: Maybe she will come to the party.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ʃi wɪl kʌm tə ðə ˈpɑːrti/

concept_examples.text: It might rain tomorrow.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt reɪn təˈmɒroʊ/

concept_examples.text: He could be at work right now.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hi kʊd bi æt wɜːrk raɪt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: That must be Juan at the door.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðæt mʌst bi wɑːn æt ðə dɔːr/

common_error.explanation: Ngesiporutheni ngenkathi siya 'puede que ella venga' sibe sekuqalisana ukusebenzisa 'to' emva kwesiNgisi 'may' noma 'might'. Kepha ngesiNgisi, emva kwemivhesi eziyingozi (may, might, could, must) siyanisa isibhalo esingekho 'to'. Khumbula: ivhesi eziyingozi + isibhalo esisodwa.

examples.original: Maybe he is sick today.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi hi ɪz sɪk təˈdeɪ/
examples.note: 'Maybe' siyakhiwa ekuqaleni kwesifundo ngaleso sikhathi. Nxa siyasabelana 'perhaps', siyavuma kabanzi.

examples.original: She is probably at the office.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈprɒbəbli æt ði ˈɒfɪs/
examples.note: 'Probably' siyakhiwa emva kwesibhalo 'to be', kepha phambi kweminye amazwi: 'She probably works here'.

examples.original: They might arrive late.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt əˈraɪv leɪt/
examples.note: 'Might' iyavisa ukubanjwa okuncane noma okungavumelani. Ngesiporutheni 'puede que' + isubjunthivi.

examples.original: This could be a problem.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd bi ə ˈprɒbləm/
examples.note: 'Could' iyabalulekile kabanzi ukubanjwa ngosuku lwanamhlanje noma esizakuza, nakuba ngeminye imihla iyavisa ukwazi okwedlule.

examples.original: She may not know the answer.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi meɪ nɒt noʊ ði ˈænsər/
examples.note: Ukungavumelani lwe 'may' luyingo 'may not' (akukho 'may not' okungqikayo). Sebenzisa 'might not' ukubanjwa okuningi.

examples.original: He must be very tired after the trip.
examples.phonetic: /hi mʌst bi ˈveri ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə trɪp/
examples.note: NgesiNgisi 'must' ephambanweni siyasabelana ukubeka okuningi, hhayi ukubeka (nakuba nayo).

examples.original: She is likely to win the game.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈlaɪkli tə wɪn ðə ɡeɪm/
examples.note: Isimo 'be likely to' + isibhalo siyabalulekile ukubika ukubanjwa ngendlela efanelekileyo.

examples.original: That won't be true.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt woʊnt bi truː/
examples.note: Ukungavumelani ukubeka, siyanisa 'can't' kunokuba 'must not': 'That can't be true'.

title: Making formal requests / Ukucekisa izicelo ezimbalwa nokubhala ngokomthelela
bridge: Ngesi, sivela ukusebenzisa isicono sakho ('Would you...?', 'Would it be possible...?') kuzicelo ezimbalwa. Ngesilinganiso, ngaphandle kwesicono, kunzima ukusetshenziswa 'Would you mind...?' landatho lwendlela yokushumayela (-ing), indlela engasoze ifanele ngokwanele ngeSpanish. Qaphela ukungahambisani ngokwanele 'Would you care...?' njengokuthi '¿Te importaría...?', kuba liyavuma. Khumbula futhi ukuthi nge-English ezimbalwa, 'please' liyavuma emuva noma emva kwesiga somthelela, hhayi ekuqaleni njengesiSpanish.
rule:
Ukuwenza izicelo ezimbalwa ngesi-English (eyili B1), sebenzisa izinhlelo ezilandelayo:
1. **Would you + isiga somsebenzi...?** – 'Would you send me the report?' (Ingabe ungathumela umbhalo?). Imbalwa futhi iyasebenza.
2. **Could you + isiga somsebenzi...?** – 'Could you help me with this?' (Ingabe ungangisiza nale?). Ifanana no 'Would', kodwa ngokuncane nje engasoze imbalwa.
3. **Would you mind + isiga somsebenzi (-ing)?** – 'Would you mind closing the window?' (Ingabe uyayiziza ukuvala isikhalo?). Le ndlela imbalwa kakhulu futhi isetshenziswa kuzo zonke izinto ezingakwenza ukuba uyayiziza. Phendula 'No, not at all' uma ungayizizi.
4. **I would like to + isiga somsebenzi** – 'I would like to request a refund.' (Ngifisa ukucela ukubuyiselwa imali). Ukuziphatha izicelo zakho.
5. **Imibuzo ezimbalwa no 'Would it be possible to...?'** – 'Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?' (Ingabe kunzima ukusetha isikhathi esisha?). Imbalwa kakhulu, isetshenziswa emeyilizwini.
Khumbula: ngesi-English, 'please' iyavuma emuva komsebenzi noma emva kwesiga kombuzo, hhayi ekuqaleni njengesiSpanish. Isibonelo: 'Could you help me, please?' hhayi 'Please, could you help me?'.

concept_examples.text: Could you please send me the updated file?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː ˈpliːz sɛnd miː ðə ʌpˈdeɪtɪd faɪl/

concept_examples.text: Would you mind waiting for a moment?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː maɪnd ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔːr ə ˈmoʊmənt/

concept_examples.text: I would like to request a formal meeting.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə rɪˈkwɛst ə ˈfɔːrməl ˈmiːtɪŋ/

common_error.explanation: NgesiSpanish kunzima ukusebenzisa 'por favor' ekuqaleni (Por favor, ¿podrías ayudarme?). Ngesi-English, ezicelo ezimbalwa, 'please' iyavuma emuva noma emva kwesiga, hhayi ekuqaleni. Ukuyivala ekuqaleni kuvele kunzima noma ngokwezifundo ezimbalwa.

examples.original: Could you open the door?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː ˈoʊpən ðə dɔːr/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'could' esikhundleni se-'can' ukuze uvume ngokwengeziwe.

examples.original: Would you pass me the salt, please?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː pæs miː ðə sɔːlt pliːz/
examples.note: 'Would' imbalwa ngokwengeziwe kunokuthi 'could'.

examples.original: Would you mind speaking more slowly?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː maɪnd ˈspiːkɪŋ mɔːr ˈsloʊli/
examples.note: Emva kwesiga 'mind' sivela ukusebenzisa isiga somsebenzi no -ing.

examples.original: Would you mind if I closed the window?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː maɪnd ɪf aɪ kloʊzd ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
examples.note: No 'if' sivela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esidlulile ukuze sivume ngokwengeziwe.

examples.original: I would be grateful if you could send me the documents.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfəl ɪf juː kʊd sɛnd miː ðə ˈdɑːkjəmənts/
examples.note: Le ndlela imbalwa kakhulu futhi iyasebenza kakhulu emeyilizwini.

examples.original: Would it be possible to schedule a call for next week?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt biː ˈpɑːsəbəl tə ˈʃɛdjuːl ə kɔːl fɔːr nɛkst wiːk/
examples.translation: Ingabe kunzima ukusetha isikhathi esisha sokukhuluma ngesonto?
examples.note: 'Would it be possible' imbalwa kakhulu futhi iyavuma.
